contacts.title: Senior Executive Officer, Nuvama Private (DIFC) Limited

description: Dubai arm of Nuvama Private, the PAG-backed Indian wealth manager (formerly Edelweiss Wealth Management, India-listed). DFSA-licensed 19-Jul-2024 (CAT 3C) with a Holding/Controlling Client Assets endorsement, to serve non-resident Indians and global clients from DIFC, distributing investment products and advising on wealth. Officially launched operations 6-Aug-2024; plans to build a team of up to four bankers in Dubai. Vishwajit Patil appointed Senior Executive Officer of the DIFC entity.

Timing 20/25: new DFSA licence (19-Jul-2024) plus a well-documented public launch (Aug 2024) building a fresh Dubai team — a genuine greenfield build with no incumbent. Access 8/15: named, reachable decision-maker (Vishwajit Patil, Senior Executive Officer, LinkedIn verified) but no published direct email/phone found (ZoomInfo shows only a masked pattern, not a real found address — not used). Total 73 rounds to 74 — strong queue candidate, though worth confirming during outreach prep whether the DIFC entity actually needs a portfolio/fund system locally or leans mainly on group-wide Nuvama India infrastructure.
